description:
Mutate fields on an existing music/SFX track by id. Read existing tracks via `get_project.audio_tracks` — the per-entry shape there matches this tool's args, so you can flip a knob (volume, fades, timing, loop) and write it back without losing the track's id.

Only fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are preserved. To delete a track entirely, use `remove_from_project(target='audio')` instead.

guide_end_time.description: New end time on the project timeline (seconds)

guide_start_time.description: New start time on the project timeline (seconds)

music_end_time.description: New end offset within the source file (seconds)

music_id.description: ID of the audio track (from get_project.audio_tracks[].id)

music_start_time.description: New start offset within the source file (seconds)

name: update_audio
title: Update an existing audio track
